cohort: 3327 women at the labor ward in King Khaled University Hospital, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
finding: Grand multiparous Saudi women have similar risks of maternal and neonatal complications compared to other parity groups after adjusting for age.
mod_finding: While Cesarean delivery rates were initially higher in the grand multiparous group, after adjusting for age, grand multiparity was associated with a lower likelihood of Cesarean delivery.
